items.headline: Ex-Broncos exec John Beake, who helped land John Elway, dies at 87
items.description: John Beake, who was instrumental in the trade for John Elway and helped guide the Denver Broncos to back-to-back Super Bowl titles in the late 1990s, has died at age 87, the team said Saturday.

items.headline: Broncos' Jonathon Cooper off commissioner exempt list, could return Week 7
items.description: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper was removed from the commissioner exempt list Friday, meaning he's available to play in Week 7. Cooper, who was arrested twice in a seven-day span in June on domestic violence charges, has been on the list since Aug. 30.
